$description: The NDDev Figma library as data: variable collections (modes mirror the token resolver), effect styles and text styles bound to the variables. Generated by nddev-design-system; the library file is built from this, never edited by hand.

variables.name: mark/pip
variables.description: A 3 px pip and lane.

variables.name: mark/dot
variables.description: The small dot and its 5 px lane: kickers, the page bar, rails.

variables.name: mark/node
variables.description: A 9 px node on a time line.

variables.name: mark/dot-lg
variables.description: The 15 px dot at a heading's, a rail's or a foot's end.

variables.name: mark/stroke
variables.description: The stroke of drawn controls: a menu's bars, a chevron, a disclosure's plus.

variables.name: focus/width
variables.description: Focus outline width (WCAG 2.2 2.4.13: at least a 2 px perimeter).

variables.name: focus/gap
variables.description: Space between a control and its focus outline, filled with surface.base.

variables.name: opacity/disabled
variables.description: A disabled control (WCAG exempts it from contrast).

variables.name: opacity/overlay
variables.description: Scrim behind a dialog.

variables.name: measure/hero-lead
variables.description: A first view's intro beside its art (660 px).

variables.name: measure/hero-lead-split
variables.description: A first view's intro beside its headline (602 px).

variables.name: measure/hero-lead-centered
variables.description: A first view's intro centred (637 px).

variables.name: measure/section-title
variables.description: A block's heading on a home (910 px).

variables.name: measure/section-lead
variables.description: A block's description on a home (850 px).

variables.name: measure/note
variables.description: A note under a step or a date (256 px).

variables.name: measure/narrow
variables.description: A narrow box: a menu, a portrait (352 px).

variables.name: measure/short
variables.description: A short paragraph (448 px).

variables.name: measure/text
variables.description: A card's or a page's text (600 px).

variables.name: measure/lead
variables.description: A lead or a short heading (640 px).

variables.name: measure/wide
variables.description: A wide text (704 px).

variables.name: measure/head
variables.description: A statement's head (768 px).

variables.name: gutter
variables.description: Page gutter: 1 rem on a phone, growing to 6.25 rem.

variables.name: section-space
variables.description: Space between page sections: 4 rem on a phone, growing to 9.5 rem.

variables.name: tracking/tight
variables.description: Display headings.

variables.name: tracking/wider
variables.description: Upper-case labels and kickers.

variables.name: chart/series/1
variables.description: Okabe–Ito blue hue family; lightness set for this theme.

variables.name: chart/series/2
variables.description: Okabe–Ito orange hue family; lightness set for this theme.

variables.name: chart/series/3
variables.description: Okabe–Ito bluish green hue family; lightness set for this theme.

variables.name: chart/series/4
variables.description: Okabe–Ito vermillion hue family; lightness set for this theme.

variables.name: chart/series/5
variables.description: Okabe–Ito reddish purple hue family; lightness set for this theme.

variables.name: chart/series/6
variables.description: Okabe–Ito sky blue hue family; lightness set for this theme.

variables.name: art/specular
variables.description: The light the art's solids are lifted towards in their highlights (the tone ladder's lightest steps): white in either scheme, a theme's own where it sets one.

variables.name: button/lg/gap
variables.description: 20 px between the label and its 24 px arrow (501:3720, 488:3367).

variables.name: checkbox/gap
variables.description: 30 px from the box to its label (501:3726).

variables.name: tabs/focus-width
variables.description: The tab ring is inset because the scrolling list clips outside it; an inset ring needs more than 2 px to cover a 2 px perimeter (WCAG 2.4.13 Understanding).

textStyles.name: H1
textStyles.description: Page heading. Every heading is set in Plex Regular ; size carries the hierarchy.

textStyles.name: H4
textStyles.description: Minor heading, dialog and panel title.

textStyles.name: Lead
textStyles.description: The paragraph that opens a page or section, in the secondary text colour.

textStyles.name: Label
textStyles.description: Hints, metadata, chips and compact controls.

textStyles.name: Kicker
textStyles.description: Upper-case label over a heading or a field ; never the only cue.

textStyles.name: Code
textStyles.description: Commands, keys and code, slightly smaller than the text around it.
